en.headline: Tai Po fire inquiry report to be submitted to government on Thursday
en.dek: Sources say the independent committee investigating the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people will deliver its final report on Thursday, with a redacted public version expected next week.
body: An independent committee examining the deadly fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po is expected to submit its final report to the Hong Kong government on Thursday, according to sources familiar with the arrangement.

The South China Morning Post reported that the judge-led panel is likely to largely endorse the closing submission of its lead counsel, which pointed to a series of systemic failures. A redacted version of the report, which may withhold details to avoid prejudicing ongoing criminal proceedings, is scheduled for public release next week at the earliest.

A source said the committee would leave decisions on accountability and disciplinary action to the administration. Criminal investigations related to the fire, which killed 168 people including a firefighter, remain under way. The Chief Executive has previously pledged to pursue reforms and responsibility after receiving the report.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑大火調查報告周四交政府
zh.dek: 消息指調查委員會將於周四向政府提交最終報告，涉及168人死亡的火災，公開版本最早下周發布，部分內容或因刑事調查而被遮蔽。
body: 據熟悉安排的消息人士指，調查大埔宏福苑五級大火的獨立委員會預計於周四向香港特區政府提交最終報告。
南華早報報道，由法官領導的委員會很可能大致認同首席律師的結案陳詞，該陳詞指出一連串制度性失誤。報告的公開版本可能因避免影響正在進行的刑事程序而遮蔽部分內容，預計最早下周發布。
消息人士稱，委員會會把問責及紀律行動的決定交由行政機關處理。該火災造成168人死亡，包括一名消防員，相關刑事調查仍在進行。行政長官早前承諾收到報告後會推進改革並追究責任。
